screen.applet: from enigma import eSize listitems = self["list"] if len(listitems.list) > 2: ls = (listitems.instance.size().width(),listitems.instance.size().height()) ws = (self.instance.size().width(),self.instance.size().height()) if len(listitems.list) == 3: lsize = (ls[0],int(ls[1]*1.5)) wsize = (ws[0],ws[1]+int(ls[1]*0.5)) if len(listitems.list) == 4: lsize = (ls[0],ls[1]*2) wsize = (ws[0],ws[1]+ls[1]) listitems.instance.resize(eSize(*lsize)) pos = self["text"].instance.position().x() * 2 wwsize = (wsize[0]-pos,wsize[1]-pos) self["text"].instance.resize(eSize(*wwsize)) self["text"].setText("") self.instance.resize(eSize(*wsize))
